name: ntfy
announce: Subscribes to ntfy topics (e.g. GitHub webhooks rendered by ntfy) on one server and raises each message as an operator inbox note and, optionally, a rate-limited one-line summary to a seat — a different seat per topic. Message text arrives fenced as untrusted; tag, title and author filters drop what you do not want to hear about, including an agent's own comments. Events the github template cannot title (a fork, a star) are named from their body instead of printing <no value>, and go to your inbox without spending a seat.
